title: Per-PC memory salience
description: Preserve individual-PC important facts through summary roll-up. Scene/session/arc summaries are party-level prose with no per-PC tagging, so deaths, level-ups, and signature items can be lost. Tag per-PC salient facts via the existing salient_refs mechanism using character.id (no new tables in v1). Acceptance: scene/session salient refs can carry character ids; per-PC important facts are retrievable; tests. Heavier per-PC memory projection remains deferred.
notes: DEFERRED pending decision. A correct implementation must attribute scene state-changes to the causing PC, but character-scoped mutations usually target the acting/active PC implicitly (no explicit character arg), and the reviewed design (docs/multi-pc-design.md) deliberately did NOT persist the acting PC on turn_trace (no schema change) and explicitly defers 'heavier per-PC memory projection' until playtesting shows party-level prose loses individual arcs. summarizeSceneFromLog currently writes salientRefs:[]. Two paths to do this well: (a) add acting_character_id to turn_trace via a v9->v10 migration so scene rollup can attribute deltas deterministically; or (b) wait for playtesting per the design. Recommend (b) unless a concrete need appears.
close_reason: Added turn_trace.acting_character_id (schema v9->v10 migration) + recorded resolved acting PC per turn; summarizeSceneFromLog now derives per-PC salient refs {target:character,id,field} from the scene's traces. 5 new tests (per-PC salience x3, migration v9->v10, trace round-trip). Checkpoint round-trip verified green in isolation (65/65). Committed 6ca4bb8.
